Spray/backroll coupling enforced. Height modifiers H1-H4 applied. Texture modifiers applied. Stacking partition enforced with separate prep and coating pools.

Height H1-H4 (1.0/1.3/1.5/2.0). QT modifiers (0.8/1.0/1.3/1.5). Texture modifiers (1.0/1.1/1.15/1.25). All match registry values.

summary: SF_DRYWALL_CEILING_INT_RP_v1 passes QA with 3 major issues — all fixed during Critic stage. Issues were zone ID mismatches between sop_modules.json and resolution.json (ceiling_fixture_covers→ceiling_fixtures, wall_top_line→wall_top_mask, furniture_room→furniture_drip_cover). All cross-file threading validates. All enum values, prefixes, and structural keys are compliant. Spray/backroll coupling constraint met. Overhead penalty consistently applied (15-20% vs wall RP). Stacking partition enforced. 54 tasks across 8 modules, 6 material systems, 4 round configs, 21 factor modifiers. Ready for spec.json assembly.
